Password Generator

Generate strong, random passwords with full control over length and character sets. Passwords are created locally in your browser — nothing is ever sent anywhere.

Passwords are generated locally in your browser using the Web Crypto API and are never sent anywhere. For important accounts, store them in a password manager.

📖 How to use

  1. Drag the length slider to choose 8 to 64 characters.
  2. Tick the character sets you want to include.
  3. Click Generate Password to create one.
  4. Use the strength meter as a guide and copy your password.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How strong is a 16-character password?

With all character sets enabled it has roughly 105 bits of entropy, which is effectively unbreakable by brute force. The strength meter shows the estimate for your exact settings.

Are my passwords sent to a server?

No. Generation uses your browser’s built-in cryptographic random number generator (Web Crypto API) and nothing ever leaves your device.

Should I include symbols?

Symbols increase the character pool and therefore strength. Some older sites reject them, so you can turn them off if needed.
